Class QueryAggregateResult

public class QueryAggregateResult

Wrapper class for AggregateResult query results returned by selector classes. Provides typed access to aggregate results with convenience methods for checking emptiness, retrieving values as String, Integer, or Decimal, and handling query exceptions.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
